items.original_question: Find the spec and section for Table 8.1-1 of spec 38.423 (table-provenance lookup).
items.source: Frozen source SQLite projection; not original archive validation
items.uncapped_zero_inclusive_sql:
SELECT rk.node_id,rk.specNumber,rk.specRelease,t.node_id,t.tableId,
                                   a.node_id,a.sectionId,a.sectionNumber
                            FROM TSTable t JOIN rel_TABLE_IN_SECTION e ON e.src_id=t.node_id JOIN Section a ON a.node_id=e.dst_id
                            JOIN rel_BELONGS_TO_SPEC bs ON bs.src_id=a.node_id
                            JOIN Spec rk ON rk.node_id=bs.dst_id
                            WHERE rk.specNumber=? AND t.tableNumber=?
                            ORDER BY rk.node_id,t.node_id,a.node_id
